title: MLINE-referenced simple LTYPE with one XDATA entity-handle reference

scope.source: Runtime-generated DXF records; no repository drawing fixture is used or added.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0, alignment 65.

documents.title: DXF Group Codes in Numerical Order Reference
documents.relevant_rule: Group 1005 is an entity handle in extended data, encoded as a hexadecimal string of up to 16 digits.

documents.title: Persistent Inter-Object Reference Handles (DXF)
documents.relevant_rule: XDATA group 1005 handles behave as soft pointers and translate when referenced objects are copied or inserted.

proof.source: Physical LTYPE XDATA, its captured code-1005 object-ID role, complete ENTITIES source/delivery spans, parser addLine event, observed DRW_Line, unique live LINE, source owner and non-collision identity entry all bind the same source handle. The raw and typed XDATA handle values must agree.
proof.output: The selected handle is preallocated before LTYPE emission and remapped through the entity identity map. Staged output checks exact LTYPE XDATA order/value, one emitted LINE identity in ENTITIES, its remapped model-space BLOCK_RECORD owner, and a fresh import whose typed 1005 value names that LINE.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the target LINE refuses export and preserves the destination sentinel; restoring the LINE succeeds on the same adapter. A late LINE-handle mutation after APPID emission also refuses atomically; restoring the source handle succeeds on the same adapter.

limits: This receipt covers one code-1005 handle to one typed LINE in ENTITIES, owned by model space, in one selected AC1027 simple-LTYPE XDATA profile under one bare APPID. Other target record types/sections, multiple handles, other XDATA compositions, additional APPID groups/metadata, LTYPE schemas and versions remain unqualified.
The receipt proves transport and identity remapping only. It does not establish application-specific XDATA meaning, MLINE rendering, recursive document closure or broader LTYPE provider support.
